ReadMainFS: Reads file from MainFS, allocating space. A0=DDDDFFFF
FreeMainFS: Free's an allocated MainFS file pointer
FindFormEntry: Finds a FORM entry. A0=entry type (like "OBJ1")
Convert3DTo2D: A0=3 point vector,returns 2D point within (0,0) [upper left] to (320,240) [lower right]
MakePermHeap: A0=heap_addr,A1=heap_len,calls MakeHeap and persists pointer in 800D6030
FreePerm: A0=addr,frees in the permanent heap, really an alias for normal free
MakeTempHeap: A0=heap_addr,A1=heap_len,calls MakeHeap and persists pointer in 800D6040
FreeTemp: A0=addr,frees in the temp heap, really an alias for normal free
DirectionPrompt: Prompts player to choose path at branch
ShowPlayerCoinChange: A0=player_index,A1=amount (signed),shows coins +/- next to player ui\
GetSpaceData: A0=space_index,Gets pointer to the space data originating from the board def
GetAbsSpaceIndexFromChainSpaceIndex: A0=chain_index,A1=space_index_in_chain gets true space index from chain+index
GetChainSpaceIndexFromAbsSpaceIndex: A0=abs_space_index,A1=chain_index,returns -1 if abs space not in chain
EventTableHydrate: Moves event table data into the space data
SetPlayerBlue: Sets the player's turn state blue
SetPlayerRed: Sets the player's turn state red
SetPlayerGreen: Sets the player's turn state green
GetSumOfPlayerStars: sums the star count of all players
RNGPercentChance: A0=percent chance the call returns true
GetTurnsRemaining: Subtracts elapsed turns from total turns
SetPlayerOntoChain: A0=player_index,A1=chain,A2=space, sets cur and next data, assuming next is cur+1
CreateTextWindow: creates a text window based on upper left x and y coordinate, and the number of characters on the x and y axis
GetPlayerStruct: A0=player_index pass -1 to get current player's struct
PlayerIsCurrent: A0=player_index tests if A0 is the current player
PlayerHasCoins: A0=player_index,A1=min_coints tests if player coins >= A1
ClearPlayer0x20: clears all 0x20 entries in player structs
AdjustPlayerCoinsGradual: A0=player_index,A1=amount,like AdjustPlayerCoins but with sounds one at a time
MakeHeap: A0=addr,A1=size,instantiates the heap by writing initial header
guOrthoF: Calculate a positive projection matrix (floating point)
guPerspective: Calculate a perspective drawing projection matrix.
guPerspectiveF: Calculate a perspective drawing projection matrix (floating point)
osVirtualToPhysical: Translates between CPU virtual address/physical memory address
bzero: Writes all zeroes,A0=ram_addr,A1=len_to_clear,may need to be 0x20 divisible,may do other stuff?
_ldexpf: multiply floating-point number by integral power of 2
_frexpf: convert floating-point number to fractional and integral components
cur_board_scene_state: Determines how the board scene starts up when (re)loaded
jt_spacetype_to_turneffect: Jump table for space type to turn effect
main_fs_dir_count: Number of directories in main filesystem
main_fs_cur_dir_file_count: Count of files in directory being accessed
space_data: pointer to space data parsed from board def file
chain_data_addr: pointer to array of chain lengths and indices
times_passed_start: Number of times the start space has been passed
p1_turn_status: Color based on type of space landed on
p1_total_happening_spaces: Player 1 total number of Happening Spaces landed on
p1_total_red_spaces: Player 1 total number of red spaces landed on
p1_total_blue_spaces: Player 1 total number of blue spaces landed on
p1_total_minigame_spaces: Player 1 total number of Mini-Game spaces landed on
p1_total_chance_spaces: Player 1 total number of Chance Time spaces landed on
p1_total_mushroom_spaces: Player 1 total number of Mushroom spaces landed on
p1_total_bowser_spaces: Player 1 total number of Bowser spaces landed on
